entries.headline: USAF transports and elevated Taiwan-area activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne across the Pacific and North America, and said air activity near Taiwan was nearly four times its usual level.

entries.headline: Suspilne Kyiv metro-station damage report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that a Russian attack on Kyiv damaged a metro station on the left bank, citing Mayor Vitali Klitschko, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Putin trilateral-meeting proposal reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that Vladimir Putin proposed a meeting next month with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to discuss the war. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF transports, coded broadcasts and Gulf activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne across multiple regions, three coded radio broadcasts during the preceding hour, and Gulf-region air activity at three times its usual level.

entries.headline: TWZ fighter-drone control report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a TWZ report that an F-22 pilot controlled an FQ-44 fighter drone from the cockpit for the first time. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Insider Paper Canada-base incident report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Insider Paper report that a serious incident at a Canadian base caused deaths and sparked a fire. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: CASH71 T-6 Texan II sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Beechcraft T-6 Texan II using callsign CASH71, hex code AE110D and registration 01-3625. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Six USAF transport aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including multiple large cargo aircraft, and said no coded radio broadcasts were detected during that hour.

entries.headline: Cargo aircraft, radar aircraft and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five military cargo aircraft and a radar aircraft airborne over the United States, and said nine coded radio broadcasts had been heard that day, with the latest about an hour earlier.

entries.headline: US military transports and surveillance jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large U.S. military transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and across the United States, together with a U.S. Air Force radar-surveillance aircraft.

entries.headline: Six USAF heavy-lift transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force heavy-lift transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, and said eastern Mediterranean air activity was nearly three times its usual level.

entries.headline: Reuters Iran defence-minister report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that Iran’s parliament approved Mehrdad Akhlaqi as defence minister, and said three outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that the U.S. Navy awarded Boeing up to $80 million to improve the MQ-25A Stingray drone.
